name: SIDEUP: Saudi Shipping & COD for WooCommerce
author: sideupksa

sections.description:
Stop juggling courier portals. Copying orders into one courier’s portal after another, fixing wrong addresses and waiting on your cash on delivery money eats your day. SIDEUP puts Saudi Arabia’s top couriers inside your WooCommerce admin, behind one account and one account manager.

Every store gets a dedicated account manager, a real person you can reach when a shipment needs attention.

Why merchants use SIDEUP

  • Top Saudi couriers, one dashboard. Aramex, J&T Express, SMSA Express and RedBox, all through a single SIDEUP account.
  • Compare rates, then ship. Click Ship on an order, see each courier’s price for that city and payment method, pick one, done.
  • National Address built in. Customers can enter their National Address short code at checkout. When you ship, SIDEUP looks it up and selects the right city and area, in Arabic, so fewer parcels go to the wrong place.
  • Cash on delivery, payment link or pre-paid. Choose how the customer pays when you ship. COD is collected for you, and payment link orders show the customer’s link right in your orders list.
  • Bulk shipping. Select orders and ship them together with the bulk action.
  • Live status in your orders list. SIDEUP status, tracking number and payment link appear as columns on the WooCommerce Orders screen.
  • Returns and exchanges handled. Returned shipments are tracked and handled through SIDEUP and your account manager.
  • Full SIDEUP dashboard. Print AWBs, follow every shipment and see your delivery and return analytics in your SIDEUP dashboard, one click away from WordPress.

Pricing

The plugin is free. Shipping is billed through your SIDEUP account, either pay as you go or with a SIDEUP bundle. For bundle merchants, the price shown when you ship already includes the COD or payment link fees.

Works with

Aramex, J&T Express, SMSA Express and RedBox. Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

بالعربي

أقوى شركات الشحن بالمملكة، من داخل ووكومرس. SIDEUP يربط أرامكس وJ&T وسمسا وريدبوكس بلوحة تحكم ووكومرس مباشرة. قارن الأسعار، اختر شركة الشحن، واشحن طلب واحد أو طلبات كثيرة دفعة وحدة. العميل يكتب رمز العنوان الوطني المختصر عند الدفع، وعند الشحن تتحدد المدينة والحي تلقائياً. اختر الدفع عند الاستلام أو رابط الدفع أو مدفوع مسبقاً، وتابع حالة كل شحنة ورقم التتبع من صفحة الطلبات. المرتجع والاستبدال؟ لا تشيل همّ، ولكل متجر مدير حساب مخصص.

الإضافة مجانية. الشحن يُحاسب من حسابك على SIDEUP، بالدفع حسب الاستخدام أو بباقة SIDEUP.

External services

This plugin connects to the SIDEUP shipping and fulfillment service (operated by SIDEUP) to provide its core functionality: sending your WooCommerce orders to SIDEUP for delivery and retrieving their shipment and payment status.

The plugin contacts the SIDEUP API at https://portal.beta.sa.sideup.co/api/ only after you have entered your SIDEUP API key in WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > SIDEUP. No data is sent before the API key is configured.

What data is sent and when:

  • When you open the WooCommerce Orders screen, the plugin sends your orders’ order keys to SIDEUP to retrieve their current shipment and payment status.
  • When you request shipment for an order (individually or via the bulk action), the plugin sends that order’s details — customer name, phone number, shipping address, city/state, order total, ordered items, and the optional National Address field — to SIDEUP so the shipment can be created.

This service is required for the plugin to function. By entering your API key you agree to SIDEUP’s terms and privacy policy:

  • Terms of Service: https://portal.sideup.co/terms-and-conditions
  • Privacy Policy: https://portal.sideup.co/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins -> Add New, search for “SIDEUP” and click Install Now, then Activate. (Or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/sideup-shipping-ksa.)
  2. Go to WooCommerce -> Settings -> Shipping -> SIDEUP.
  3. Paste your API key. You will find it in your SIDEUP dashboard under Integrations, or ask your Account Manager.
  4. Open WooCommerce -> Orders and click Ship on any order.

Don’t have a SIDEUP account yet? Sign up at https://sa.sideup.co/ and an account manager will get you set up.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes. The plugin is free. Shipping is billed through your SIDEUP account, pay as you go or with a SIDEUP bundle.

Do I need a SIDEUP account?

Yes. The plugin connects your store to your SIDEUP merchant account, which needs an API key. Sign up at https://sa.sideup.co/.

Where do I find my API key?

In your SIDEUP dashboard under the Integrations tab, or ask your account manager.

Which couriers can I ship with?

Aramex, J&T Express, SMSA Express and RedBox. When you click Ship, the dialog shows every courier that serves that city, with its price.

What is the National Address field?

An optional checkout field where the customer enters their Saudi National Address short code (for example AAAA1234). When you ship the order, SIDEUP looks the code up, selects the matching city and area, and sends the National Address with the shipment. You can also type or correct the code in the shipping dialog.

Which payment methods are supported?

Cash on delivery, payment link and pre-paid. You choose one when you ship the order. Credit card orders paid in your store are sent with zero cash collection.

What happens if a customer refuses the order?

The shipment is returned to you and its status updates in your orders list. Your account manager can help with re-delivery, exchange or the return.

Does it work with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. The plugin supports both the HPOS orders screen and the legacy posts-based orders screen.

How do I get support?

Contact your dedicated account manager, or reach SIDEUP through https://sa.sideup.co/.
